claim: In a unanimous per curiam decision the same day, the Court granted immunity to officers who fatally shot Dominic Rollice as he raised a hammer, holding "the officers plainly did not violate any clearly established law."
evidence: On this record, the officers plainly did not violate any clearly established law.
excerpt:
On this record, the officers plainly did not violate any clearly established law.

The Court relied most heavily on Allen . But the facts of Allen are dramatically different from the facts here. The officers in Allen responded to a potential suicide call by sprinting toward a parked car, screaming at the suspect, and attempting to physically wrest a gun from his hands. 119 F. 3d, at 841. Officers Girdner and Vick, by contrast, engaged in a conversation with Rollice, followed him into a garage at a distance of 6 to 10 feet, and did not yell until after he picked up a hammer.
